ranked_evidence.title: Ramdev: Doctors furious over yoga guru's insulting Covid remark
ranked_evidence.snippet: # Ramdev: Doctors furious over yoga guru's insulting Covid remark. **Doctors in India have hit out against yoga guru Baba Ramdev over his controversial statements against modern medicine.**. He recently said that tens of thousands died of Covid after taking modern medicines and mocked patients for trying to get oxygen cylinders. But he again took a swipe at modern medicine on Monday for not having a cure for some diseases. Modern, science-based medicine is the backbone of India's healthcare systems, but alternative therapies like ayurveda and homoeopathy are also hugely popular. The Indian Medical Association (IMA), an organisation that represents doctors in India, has criticised the guru for his "insensitive" remarks in the middle of the pandemic. Doctors the BBC spoke to said such statements from a guru with millions of followers were "irresponsible and demoralising". It's not clear when he made the statement, but he is heard making references to oxygen shortages in several cities in April and May.
